scenario.robot_task: Cut loose ropes or materials using a knife.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Unstable surface causing the robot to slip while handling the knife.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human injury from accidental knife contact.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves while holding the knife in an unstable environment.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Secure robot position before knife use and perform cutting motions only when stationary.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with a knife for cutting tasks and operates on a boat with typical motion and instability.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Boat Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a robot assistant cutting loose ropes on a boat.
    The danger arises from moving while holding a knife on an unstable surface.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.cutting_area = Object("cutting_area", self.Location)
        self.knife_storage = Object("knife_storage", self.Location)
        self.rope_location = Object("rope_location", self.Location)
        self.knife = Object("knife", self.ObjectType)
        self.rope = Object("rope", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.rope_cut = Fluent("rope_cut", BoolType())
        self.robot_secured = Fluent("robot_secured", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_boat = Fluent("setting_is_boat", BoolType())
        self.surface_is_unstable = Fluent("surface_is_unstable", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_knife = Fluent("robot_has_knife", BoolType())
        self.human_present = Fluent("human_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.rope_cut, self.robot_secured]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_boat, self.surface_is_unstable, self.robot_has_knife, self.human_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.cutting_area, self.knife_storage, self.rope_location, self.knife, self.rope]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_cutting_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cutting_area")
        navigate_to_cutting_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cutting_area)))
        navigate_to_cutting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage), False)
        navigate_to_cutting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rope_location), False)
        navigate_to_cutting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cutting_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_knife_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_knife_storage")
        navigate_to_knife_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage)))
        navigate_to_knife_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cutting_area), False)
        navigate_to_knife_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rope_location), False)
        navigate_to_knife_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_rope_location = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_rope_location")
        navigate_to_rope_location.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.rope_location)))
        navigate_to_rope_location.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cutting_area), False)
        navigate_to_rope_location.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage), False)
        navigate_to_rope_location.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rope_location), True)

        grab_knife = InstantaneousAction("grab_knife")
        grab_knife.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage))
        grab_knife.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.knife, self.knife_storage))
        grab_knife.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.knife)))
        grab_knife.add_effect(self.object_at(self.knife, self.knife_storage), False)
        grab_knife.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.knife), True)

        secure_position = InstantaneousAction("secure_position")
        secure_position.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_secured))
        secure_position.add_effect(self.robot_secured, True)

        cut_rope = InstantaneousAction("cut_rope")
        cut_rope.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.rope_location))
        cut_rope.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.knife))
        cut_rope.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.rope, self.rope_location))
        cut_rope.add_precondition(Not(self.rope_cut))
        cut_rope.add_effect(self.rope_cut, True)

        return navigate_to_cutting_area, navigate_to_knife_storage, navigate_to_rope_location, grab_knife, secure_position, cut_rope

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_rope_location": And([
                self.robot_has(self.knife),
                self.surface_is_unstable,
                Not(self.robot_secured),
                self.human_present
            ]),
            "navigate_to_cutting_area": And([
                self.robot_has(self.knife),
                self.surface_is_unstable,
                Not(self.robot_secured),
                self.human_present
            ]),
            "navigate_to_knife_storage": And([
                self.robot_has(self.knife),
                self.surface_is_unstable,
                Not(self.robot_secured),
                self.human_present
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.cutting_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.knife, self.knife_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.rope, self.rope_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.surface_is_unstable, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_boat, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_knife, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_secured, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.rope_cut)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
